label: Support tickets
title: Will this ticket escalate?
description: Predict escalation and time to resolution from the conversation available at triage.
code:
import relflow as rf


class TicketMessage(rf.Branch):
    """One message in a support ticket conversation."""

    author = rf.Category
    body = rf.Text
    minutes_since_previous = rf.Number


class TicketModel(rf.Model):
    """A support ticket and its conversation at triage."""

    product = rf.Category
    priority = rf.Enum("low", "normal", "high")
    messages = TicketMessage(length=64, overflow="tail")
    escalated = rf.Boolean(predict=True)
    hours_to_resolve = rf.Number(predict=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = TicketModel(preset="small")

label: Customer churn
title: Who is likely to leave?
description: Predict cancellation within 90 days from a subscriber's usage and support history.
code:
import relflow as rf


class MonthlyUsage(rf.Branch):
    """One month of a subscriber's product usage."""

    month = rf.Period("month_of_year")
    minutes = rf.Number
    data_gb = rf.Number
    overage_fee = rf.Number


class SupportTicket(rf.Branch):
    """One support ticket in a subscriber's history."""

    channel = rf.Category
    resolved = rf.Boolean
    days_open = rf.Number


class ChurnModel(rf.Model):
    """A subscriber with usage and support histories."""

    plan = rf.Category
    tenure_months = rf.Number
    monthly_usage = MonthlyUsage(length=12, overflow="tail")
    support_tickets = SupportTicket(length=32, overflow="tail")
    churn_90d = rf.Boolean(predict=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = ChurnModel(preset="small")

label: Demand forecasting
title: What will sell in the weeks ahead?
description: Predict units for each future week using sales history and planned promotions.
code:
import relflow as rf


class SalesWeek(rf.Branch):
    """One week of observed sales for a store and product."""

    week = rf.Period("week_of_year")
    units_sold = rf.Number
    promotion = rf.Boolean
    stockout = rf.Boolean


class ForecastWeek(rf.Branch):
    """One supplied future week to forecast."""

    week = rf.Period("week_of_year")
    promotion = rf.Boolean
    units_sold = rf.Number(predict=True)


class DemandModel(rf.Model):
    """A product at one store, with past and future weeks."""

    store = rf.Category
    sku = rf.Category
    history = SalesWeek(length=104, overflow="tail")
    horizon = ForecastWeek(length=12, overflow="error")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = DemandModel(preset="small")

label: Credit risk
title: Will this applicant default?
description: Predict default within 12 months from the application, open accounts and recent inquiries.
code:
import relflow as rf


class CreditAccount(rf.Branch):
    """One of the applicant's existing credit accounts."""

    account_type = rf.Category
    balance = rf.Number
    months_open = rf.Number
    missed_payments = rf.Number


class CreditInquiry(rf.Branch):
    """One recent credit inquiry for the applicant."""

    lender = rf.Category
    age_days = rf.Number


class CreditModel(rf.Model):
    """A loan application with accounts and credit inquiries."""

    product = rf.Category
    requested_amount = rf.Number
    accounts = CreditAccount(length=64, overflow="error")
    inquiries = CreditInquiry(length=32, overflow="tail")
    default_12m = rf.Boolean(predict=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = CreditModel(preset="small")

label: Predictive maintenance
title: Which assets may fail?
description: Predict failure within 30 days from sensor readings and completed maintenance work.
code:
import relflow as rf


class SensorReading(rf.Branch):
    """One sensor observation from an asset."""

    hour = rf.Period("hour_of_day")
    vibration = rf.Number
    temperature = rf.Number
    load = rf.Number


class WorkOrder(rf.Branch):
    """One completed maintenance job on an asset."""

    type = rf.Category
    parts_replaced = rf.Set
    age_days = rf.Number


class MaintenanceModel(rf.Model):
    """An asset with sensor and maintenance histories."""

    asset_type = rf.Category
    age_years = rf.Number
    sensor_readings = SensorReading(length=168, overflow="tail")
    work_orders = WorkOrder(length=32, overflow="tail")
    failure_30d = rf.Boolean(predict=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = MaintenanceModel(preset="small")

label: Insurance claims
title: What payout is likely?
description: Predict payout and fraud for each submitted claim, using invoice evidence available at review.
code:
import relflow as rf


class LineItem(rf.Branch):
    """One billed item within a claim invoice."""

    code = rf.Category
    amount = rf.Number


class Invoice(rf.Branch):
    """One provider's invoice and its billed items."""

    provider = rf.Hash
    line_items = LineItem(length=32, overflow="error")


class Claim(rf.Branch):
    """One insurance claim with its supporting invoices."""

    cause = rf.Category
    reported_after_days = rf.Number
    invoices = Invoice(length=16, overflow="error")
    paid_amount = rf.Number(predict=True)
    is_fraudulent = rf.Boolean(predict=True)


class ClaimsModel(rf.Model):
    """A policy with claims submitted for review."""

    policy_type = rf.Category
    coverage_limit = rf.Number
    claims = Claim(length=32, overflow="error")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = ClaimsModel(preset="small")
